title: Female Filmmakers Weigh in on Merger and Supporting Each Other in Hollywood’s Hard Times at Through Her Lens Luncheon
summary: Halle Berry, Regina King, Celine Song, Gina Prince-Bythewood, Patty Jenkins, Emmy Rossum and H.E.R. stepped out at the event, put on by Chanel and Tribeca Enterprises.

title: 72% of Americans would slow financial progress to enjoy life now, SoFi survey finds
summary: SoFi found 72% of Americans are willing to make slower progress on financial goals to prioritize family, travel and meaningful experiences.
